content: संवृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To turn or go towards, approach. .²2 To attack, assault (with <ab>acc.</ab>). .²3 To be or become; ते यथोक्ताः संवृत्ताः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²4 To happen, take place, occur. .²5 To be produced, arise, spring. .²6 To be accomplished. .²7 To be united, meet together. .²8 To fall to the lot of. .²9 To be fulfilled (as time); वसाचलेऽस्मिन् मृगराजसेविते संवर्तयञ्शत्रुवधे समर्थः <ls>Rām. 4. 27. 48</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cast, throw. .²2 To accomplish, fulfil; पश्येयमिति तस्याश्च कामः संवर्त्यतामयम् <ls>Rām. 7. 46. 23</ls>. .²3 To wrap up, envelop. .²4 To crumble up. .²5 To destroy, crush.
